title: Vegan Dense Indian Mitsuba Idli
description: A jammy, dense, and flavorful Indian dish featuring mitsuba, perfect for a weeknight dinner, made vegan-friendly and cooked to perfection in an air fryer.
instructions: Soak idli rice and urad dal in separate containers overnight.
Drain and grind the soaked idli rice and urad dal into a smooth batter.
Add chopped mitsuba, onion, ginger, curry leaves, and salt to the batter and mix well.
Add water to the batter and mix until the desired consistency is achieved.
Pour the batter into idli molds and place them in the air fryer basket.
Cook the idlis in the air fryer at 375 degrees Fahrenheit for 15 minutes.
Remove the idlis from the air fryer and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the idlis hot with your favorite chutney or sambar.
